name: King's Pawn Opening
plan_white: Good start. You're claiming the center and opening lines for your bishop and queen. Next, bring out your knights and castle.
plan_black: White grabbed the center. Answer with e5 for open play, or c5 or e6 for something sharper.

name: Queen's Pawn Opening
plan_white: Solid central start. Develop your knights, bring your bishops out, and castle early.
plan_black: Fight for the center with d5, or play Nf6 to keep options open.

name: English Opening
plan_white: A flexible start that controls d5. Play Nc3, g3 and Bg2, and fight for the center later.
plan_black: Take your share of the center with e5 or Nf6, and develop calmly.

name: Reti Opening
plan_white: A flexible start. Develop, castle, and decide on pawn moves like d4 or c4 later.
plan_black: Play d5 and Nf6, and take the center while White waits.

name: Bird's Opening
plan_white: You're controlling e5. Play Nf3, e3 and Be2, but be careful of the weakened king side.
plan_black: Take the center with d5 or e5, and watch for chances against White's king side.

name: Nimzo-Larsen Attack
plan_white: Your bishop on b2 will eye the long diagonal. Develop and castle, and look for a later e4.
plan_black: Take the center with e5 or d5, and develop your pieces.

name: Polish Opening
plan_white: Your bishop on b2 targets the long diagonal. Don't over-extend the queen side pawns, and develop quickly.
plan_black: Take the center with e5 or d5. The b4 pawn can become a target.

name: Grob Opening
plan_white: Risky. Your bishop on g2 targets the long diagonal, but your king side is loose. Develop and be careful.
plan_black: Punish it by taking the center with d5, and attack the g4 pawn with Bxg4 if it's safe.

name: King's Pawn Game
plan_white: Develop with Nf3 to attack e5, then Bc4 or Bb5, and castle.
plan_black: Defend e5 with Nc6, then develop your bishop and knight and castle.

name: King's Knight Opening
plan_white: Develop your bishop with Bc4 or Bb5, castle, and prepare d4 or c3.
plan_black: Defend e5 with Nc6, then develop quickly and castle.

name: Latvian Gambit
plan_white: Black's f5 weakens their king. Take it with Nxe5, then develop quickly and aim at their king.
plan_black: A risky gambit. You're after fast attacks, but your king is exposed, so develop fast.

name: Elephant Gambit
plan_white: Take on d5 with exd5, then defend your e5 pawn and develop.
plan_black: A gambit. You're giving up a pawn for quick development, so play ...Bd6 and castle quickly.

name: Petrov's Defense
plan_white: Don't grab e5 too soon. Play Nxe5 only if you play d4 next, or choose d4 or Nc3 and develop.
plan_black: A solid, mirror-like defense. Develop with d6, Be7 and castle, and don't be afraid of equality.

name: Stafford Gambit
moves: e4 e5 Nf3 Nf6 Nxe5 Nc6
plan_white: Don't panic. Take the knight on c6 and play d4 and Nc3, and develop. You're a pawn up.
plan_black: A trappy gambit. You're a pawn down, and you're hoping for quick development and Bc5 and Ng4 ideas.

name: Philidor Defense
plan_white: Play d4 to grab the center. Black's position is solid but cramped.
plan_black: Solid but passive. Play Nf6, Be7 and castle, and break with ...exd4 or ...d5 when ready.

name: Ponziani Opening
plan_white: You're preparing d4 to build a big center. Follow with d4, Bd3 and Nbd2.
plan_black: Answer with ...Nf6 or ...d5 to hit the center straight away.

name: Scotch Game
plan_white: Open the center. After ...exd4, recapture with Nxd4 and develop Nc3 and Bc4 with an active position.
plan_black: Take with exd4, then develop with Nf6 or Bc5 and challenge the knight on d4.

name: Four Knights Game
moves: e4 e5 Nf3 Nc6 Nc3 Nf6
plan_white: Solid development. Play Bb5 or d4, then castle and look for a central break.
plan_black: Mirror White's development with Bb4 or Bc5, then castle.

name: Halloween Gambit
moves: e4 e5 Nf3 Nc6 Nc3 Nf6 Nxe5
plan_white: You've sacrificed a knight for the center. Push d4 and e5 and aim to gain space and tempo.
plan_black: Take the knight with Nxe5, then play d5 or Nxe4. You're a piece up, so stay calm and don't greedily grab pawns.

name: Ruy Lopez
plan_white: A classic. Castle, play c3 and d4 to build the center, and keep pressure on the knight on c6.
plan_black: Play a6 to question the bishop, then Nf6, Be7 and castle. Stay solid and fight for the center with ...d5 later.

name: Italian Game
plan_white: Your bishop aims at f7, the weakest point. Castle, then play c3 and d4 to grab the center.
plan_black: Develop with Bc5 or Nf6, and watch f7, which only the king defends. Castle and fight for the center with ...d5.
trap: Be careful with f7: it's only defended by the king.

name: Giuoco Piano
moves: e4 e5 Nf3 Nc6 Bc4 Bc5
plan_white: Play c3 and d4 to take the center, castle, and keep your pieces active.
plan_black: Develop with Nf6, d6 and castle, and meet c3 and d4 with ...exd4.

name: Evans Gambit
moves: e4 e5 Nf3 Nc6 Bc4 Bc5 b4
plan_white: You're offering a pawn for quick development. After Bxb4, play c3 and d4 to grab the center.
plan_black: Take the pawn if you like, but return it at the right moment, and play ...d6 and ...Nf6 and castle.

name: Two Knights Defense
moves: e4 e5 Nf3 Nc6 Bc4 Nf6
plan_white: Play d3 or Ng5 for a sharp game. Ng5 threatens f7, but it needs care.
plan_black: Counterattack the e4 pawn, and be ready for Ng5.

name: Two Knights Defense, Knight Attack
moves: e4 e5 Nf3 Nc6 Bc4 Nf6 Ng5
plan_white: You're threatening Nxf7. If Black plays ...d5, take with exd5 and don't retreat too early.
plan_black: Play ...d5 to block the bishop. After exd5, play ...Na5, not ...Nxd5, to avoid the Fried Liver.
trap: After ...d5 exd5, Black's ...Nxd5 allows Nxf7, the Fried Liver Attack.

name: Fried Liver Attack
moves: e4 e5 Nf3 Nc6 Bc4 Nf6 Ng5 d5 exd5 Nxd5 Nxf7
plan_white: You've sacrificed a knight to drag the king out. Keep the attack going with Qf3 check and Nc3.
plan_black: Take the knight with the king, then try to survive and consolidate. Next time, play ...Na5 instead of ...Nxd5.

name: Traxler Counterattack
moves: e4 e5 Nf3 Nc6 Bc4 Nf6 Ng5 Bc5
plan_white: Don't panic. Safest is Bxf7 check or Nxf7, and keep your king safe.
plan_black: A wild counterattack. You're threatening Bxf2 check, so keep the tempo going.

name: Bishop's Opening
plan_white: Develop, castle and play Nf3 and d3 or c3.
plan_black: Play Nf6 to attack e4, and develop sensibly.

name: Vienna Game
plan_white: Keep options open, and play f4 or Nf3 and Bc4 and castle.
plan_black: Play Nf6 and ...Bb4, or ...Nc6, and fight for the center.

name: Vienna Gambit
plan_white: Open the f-file, grab the center with fxe5 and e5, and attack.
plan_black: Answer in the center with ...d5, and watch your king.

name: King's Gambit
plan_white: You're giving a pawn for open lines and fast development. Play Nf3, Bc4 and d4, and attack.
plan_black: Take with exf4, or defend with ...Bc5 or ...d5. Keep your king safe and develop.

name: King's Gambit Accepted
plan_white: Play Nf3 and Bc4, and aim for d4. Open lines will help your attack.
plan_black: You're a pawn up. Play ...g5 or ...d6 and ...Nf6, and keep your king safe.

name: Center Game
plan_white: Don't bring your queen out early with Qxd4. Develop with Nc3 or c3, and consider a gambit.
plan_black: You've won a pawn, so develop and be ready to challenge the center.

name: Danish Gambit
plan_white: You're offering pawns for fast development. After ...dxc3, play Bc4 and Nxc3, and attack f7.
plan_black: Take one pawn and return the rest, with ...d5 to blunt the bishops.

name: Sicilian Defense
plan_white: Play Nf3 and d4 to open the center, and develop quickly.
plan_black: A fighting defense. You're making an unbalanced game, then aim to develop and castle.

name: Smith-Morra Gambit
plan_white: Offer the pawn for fast development. After ...dxc3, recapture with Nxc3 and play Bc4 and castle.
plan_black: Take the pawn and stay solid, or decline with ...d5.

name: Closed Sicilian
plan_white: Play g3, Bg2 and Nge2, and attack on the king side with f4.
plan_black: Develop with ...Nc6, ...g6 and ...Bg7, and attack on the queen side.

name: Sicilian Defense, Old Sicilian
plan_white: Play d4 to open the center, or Bb5 for a calmer game.
plan_black: Develop sensibly, and aim for ...g6 or ...e5 and castle.

name: Sicilian Defense, French Variation
plan_white: Play d4 and Nc3, and develop your pieces.
plan_black: A solid setup. Play ...d5 or ...Nc6, then castle.

name: Sicilian Defense, Modern Variations
plan_white: Play d4 and take on d4, and develop Nc3 and Be2 or Bc4.
plan_black: Continue with ...cxd4 and ...Nf6, and develop sensibly.

name: Najdorf Sicilian
moves: e4 c5 Nf3 d6 d4 cxd4 Nxd4 Nf6 Nc3 a6
plan_white: Pick a setup: Be3 and f3 and queen-side castling for an attack, or Be2 for a calm game.
plan_black: Fight for the center with ...e5 or ...e6, and counterattack on the queen side.

name: French Defense
plan_white: Take the center with d4, and play Nc3 or Nd2, and develop.
plan_black: Play ...d5 next. Your bishop on c8 is the problem piece, so find a way to free it.

name: French Defense, Exchange Variation
plan_white: A simple, symmetrical position. Develop Nf3, Bd3 and castle, and look for a small edge.
plan_black: Recapture with exd5, and develop and castle. Your position is solid.

name: French Defense, Advance Variation
plan_white: You've gained space. Support the e5 pawn with f4 and Nf3 and c3.
plan_black: Hit the base of White's chain with ...c5, and develop with ...Nc6 and ...Qb6.

name: French Defense, Tarrasch Variation
plan_white: Solid. Develop with Ngf3 and Bd3 and castle, and keep control of e5.
plan_black: Play ...c5 or ...Nf6, and fight for the center.

name: Caro-Kann Defense
plan_white: Take the center with d4, and develop. Black's setup is solid.
plan_black: A rock-solid defense. Play ...d5 next, then free your light-squared bishop before closing the pawn chain.

name: Caro-Kann Defense, Advance Variation
plan_white: You have more space. Play Nf3, Be2 and castle, and keep the center strong.
plan_black: Develop your bishop with ...Bf5, then play ...e6 and ...c5 to challenge the center.

name: Scandinavian Defense
plan_white: Take on d5 with exd5, and develop Nf3 and Nc3 and gain tempi on the queen.
plan_black: After exd5, retake with Qxd5 or Nf6. Don't leave the queen exposed to Nc3 for too long.

name: Scandinavian Defense, Main Line
plan_white: Play Nc3 to hit the queen, and develop with tempo.
plan_black: Move the queen to a5 or d6, and develop quickly and castle.

name: Alekhine's Defense
plan_white: Push e5 to gain space and play d4, but don't overextend your pawns.
plan_black: Lure White's pawns forward, then attack them. Be ready to hit the center with ...d6.

name: Pirc Defense
moves: e4 d6 d4 Nf6 Nc3 g6
plan_white: Take space. Play Be3 or f4 and Nf3 and castle, and attack.
plan_black: Play ...Bg7 and castle, and attack the center later with ...c5 or ...e5.

name: Modern Defense
plan_white: Take the center with d4 and Nc3, and develop.
plan_black: Play ...Bg7, ...d6 and castle, then challenge the center.

name: Nimzowitsch Defense
plan_white: Take the center with d4, and develop quickly.
plan_black: A flexible reply. Play ...d5 or ...e5, and develop.

name: Queen's Pawn Game
plan_white: Play c4 for the Queen's Gambit, or Nf3 and Bf4 for a solid setup.
plan_black: Develop with Nf6, e6 and c6, and be ready to castle.

name: London System
plan_white: A simple setup. Play e3, Nf3, c3, Bd3 and Nbd2, and castle.
plan_black: Develop with ...Nf6 and ...e6 and ...c5, and challenge the center.

name: London System
plan_white: A solid setup. Play e3, c3, Bd3 and Nbd2, and castle.
plan_black: Challenge the bishop with ...c5 or ...Nh5, and develop ...e6 and ...Bd6.

name: Colle System
plan_white: A simple plan. Play Bd3, Nbd2 and c3 and castle, then break with e4.
plan_black: Play ...e6, ...Bd6 and castle, and be ready to meet e4 with ...dxe4.

name: Blackmar-Diemer Gambit
moves: d4 d5 e4 dxe4 Nc3 Nf6 f3
plan_white: A gambit. You're a pawn down and playing for fast development. Play Bf4 and Qe2 and castle long, and attack.
plan_black: Take the pawn, but give it back at the right time, and be careful with ...Bg4 and ...e6.

name: Queen's Gambit
plan_white: You're challenging d5. Develop Nc3 and Nf3 and Bg5, and aim at the center.
plan_black: Play ...e6 to hold d5 or ...c6, or take the pawn with ...dxc4.

name: Queen's Gambit Accepted
plan_white: Don't rush to win back the pawn. Play Nf3 and e3, and take on c4 with the bishop.
plan_black: Don't hold the pawn. Play ...Nf6 and ...e6, and develop.

name: Queen's Gambit Declined
plan_white: Develop with Nc3 and Nf3, and Bg5 and e3, and keep the pressure on d5.
plan_black: A classic, solid setup. Play ...Nf6, ...Be7 and castle, and free your bishop later.

name: Slav Defense
plan_white: Play Nf3, Nc3 and e3, and develop. Black's setup is solid.
plan_black: A solid choice. You're protecting d5 while keeping the bishop on c8 free.

name: Chigorin Defense
plan_white: Play Nc3 and Nf3, and don't let your pawn center get weak. cxd5 is possible.
plan_black: Develop pieces quickly, and aim at White's center.

name: Indian Defense
plan_white: Play c4 and Nc3, and take space in the center.
plan_black: Flexible. Choose ...g6 and ...Bg7, or ...e6 and ...Bb4, and don't rush the center.

name: Trompowsky Attack
plan_white: Be ready to take on f6 to damage Black's pawns. Develop Nd2 and e3.
plan_black: Play ...Ne4 or ...d5, and hit the bishop.

name: Torre Attack
plan_white: A solid system. Play e3, Nbd2 and c3, and castle.
plan_black: Play ...h6 to ask the bishop, and ...d5 or ...c5 to take the center.

name: King's Indian Defense
plan_white: Take the center with Nc3 and e4, and castle. Be ready for ...e5 or ...c5.
plan_black: Play ...Bg7, ...d6 and castle, and then attack the center with ...e5, and your king-side.

name: Nimzo-Indian Defense
moves: d4 Nf6 c4 e6 Nc3 Bb4
plan_white: Play e3 and Bd3 and Nf3 and castle, or a3 to ask the bishop.
plan_black: Pin the knight and fight for e4. Castle, and decide whether to give up your bishop pair.

name: Queen's Indian Defense
moves: d4 Nf6 c4 e6 Nf3 b6
plan_white: Play g3, Bg2 and castle, or a3 and Nc3, and keep a central advantage.
plan_black: Fianchetto with ...Bb7 and control e4. Castle and develop.

name: Catalan Opening
plan_white: Play Bg2, Nf3 and castle, and use your bishop on the long diagonal.
plan_black: Fight for the center with ...d5, and be careful about the long diagonal.

name: Grunfeld Defense
moves: d4 Nf6 c4 g6 Nc3 d5
plan_white: Build a big center, and take on d5 with cxd5, or play Bg5 or Qb3.
plan_black: Let White build the center, then attack it with ...Bg7 and ...c5.

name: Dutch Defense
plan_white: Play Nf3, g3 and Bg2, or Bg5 and e3, and aim for a strong center.
plan_black: You're aiming at e4. Play ...Nf6, ...e6 and ...Be7 and castle, and be careful about your king.

name: Englund Gambit
plan_white: Take the pawn with dxe5, and play Nc3 and e4 and keep your extra pawn.
plan_black: A risky gambit. You've given a pawn for quick development, so play ...Nc6 and ...Qe7, and be careful about traps.
trap: After dxe5 Nc6 Nf3 Qe7, White shouldn't play Qd5 because of ...Qb4+ with ...Qxb2.

name: Budapest Gambit
plan_white: Take the pawn with dxe5 and play Bf4 and Nf3, and keep the extra pawn.
plan_black: Win the pawn back with ...Ng4 and ...Bc5, and develop quickly.

name: Benko Gambit
moves: d4 Nf6 c4 c5 d5 b5
plan_white: Take on b5 and develop. Keep the extra pawn safe, and keep your king safe.
plan_black: You're giving a pawn for pressure on the queen side files. Play ...a6 and open the files.

name: King's Indian Attack
plan_white: Play Bg2, castle, d3 and e4, and attack on the king side.
plan_black: Take the center with ...Nf6, ...c5 and ...Nc6, and develop.

name: English Opening, Reversed Sicilian
plan_white: It's a Sicilian with an extra tempo. Play Nc3, g3 and Bg2, and castle.
plan_black: Take the center with e5, and play ...Nf6 and ...Nc6, and develop.
